files_reviewed: .eve/dev-runtime/.../compiled-agent-manifest.json (grep for key patterns only, none found)
note: Small Twilio SMS and WhatsApp agent on the eve framework. No custom tools, so no tool labels. A generated .eve/dev-runtime snapshot is committed even though .gitignore lists .eve. The system prompt is the generic scaffold text with no business rules.

labels.what: Every completed model message is sent as an SMS or WhatsApp message to the customer with no approval or filter
Each inbound text starts a paid model run and a paid outbound message with no per-number rate limit or cost cap. The webhook signature is checked (lines 59-63), which is good

Profile traits and recent observations from the Twilio memory store are pasted into the model instructions inside <customer_context> with no escaping. Any text a customer got stored there acts as instructions
PARTICIPANT_ADDED events attach a new phone or WhatsApp identifier to a profile with no check beyond the webhook signature; wrong data in the event merges two people's history
The eve web channel uses vercelOidc, localDev and placeholderAuth. The comment says to replace the placeholder with a real auth provider before browser use, so there is no user login yet
Model name gpt-5.6-luna and a 400000 token context window hardcoded
Twilio memory base URL hardcoded; observation page size 20 hardcoded at line 73
